question: Does gold lose its essential nature when shaped into a crown or subjected to other conditions?
premises: Gold undergoes various modifications and uses.
A crown is a particular form taken by gold.
The essential nature of a substance persists through its modifications.
inference: Gold-ness remains in gold whether in a crown or in other conditions.
plain_english: In gold, whether falling, being seized, or fashioned into a crown and so on, its gold-ness remains.
